candidates.workingClaim: Which city was Nigeria's capital when the country became independent in 1960? Answer: Lagos. Proposed additional link on 10-01: nigeria-independence-1960. Abuja, today's capital, is the deliberate trap; the question rewards knowing the country's history rather than the independence date.

From which Beijing landmark did Mao Zedong proclaim the People's Republic of China in 1949? Answer: Tiananmen Gate. Proposed additional link on 10-01: peoples-republic-china-proclaimed-1949. A recognizable landmark tied to the proclamation; all four options are historic Beijing sites.

Snoopy is a character from which comic strip? Answer: Peanuts. Proposed additional link on 10-02: peanuts-debuts-1950. Light, widely recognized hook for an imageless event; all four are long-running newspaper strips.

Which of these presidents is NOT carved on Mount Rushmore? Answer: Franklin D. Roosevelt. Proposed additional link on 10-04: mount-rushmore-carving-begins-1927. Plays on the familiar Theodore/Franklin Roosevelt mix-up without listing Theodore.

Which Dutch artist painted The Night Watch? Answer: Rembrandt. Proposed additional link on 10-04: rembrandt-dies-1669. Identifies his most famous work instead of his death; all four options are Dutch painters.

Which famous writer was wounded fighting at the Battle of Lepanto in 1571? Answer: Miguel de Cervantes. Proposed additional link on 10-07: battle-of-lepanto-1571. A memorable human link to a remote battle; distractors are contemporary European writers.

The settlement of the First Opium War, extended by the 1843 Treaty of the Bogue, made China cede which island to Britain? Answer: Hong Kong Island. Proposed additional link on 10-08: treaty-of-the-bogue-1843. Gives the treaty's lasting consequence rather than clause recall; Macau is the nearby Portuguese-held trap.
